name: safe
useCase: Identify a vault or protected storage feature.
misuse: Do not use the safe alone to promise that stored information is protected.

16.reason: Short wheel spokes leave 1.25px of space to the door frame while the two attached hinge marks retain the safe silhouette.

24.reason: Longer wheel spokes retain at least 1.5px of space from the door frame without moving the wheel or its hinges.
